summary: Gentor Resources Inc., a Canadian venture issuer listed on NEX under GNT.H, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 17, 2026 press release announcing adoption of semi-annual reporting under Coordinated Blanket Order 51-933, a Canadian Securities Administrators pilot permitting eligible venture issuers to move from quarterly to semi-annual financial reporting. The US equivalent is a foreign private issuer furnishing a material disclosure on Form 6-K rather than an annual report on Form 20-F. Eligibility cited includes annual revenues under Cdn$10 million and a clean 12-month continuous disclosure record. Gentor will drop interim statements for the three-month period ending March 31 and nine-month period ending September 30, while continuing audited annual statements (due within 120 days of December 31) and six-month interim statements with MD&A (due within 60 days of June 30). No transaction terms, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock apply. Watch for any later announcement of pilot withdrawal, which would restore quarterly reporting obligations.
